I love Settlers, but I just have the 5-6 player expansion. I want to get an expansion or two, but there are a lot of them and it's a little daunting. What are the pros and cons of the many other expansions?

Some of them expand the gameplay you are familiar with, plus some additions, while others changes the game in a bigger way.
Cities & Knights, Traders & Barbarians ads layers to the board you are familiar with, they introduce conflict and more complicated buildings. But if you go for Seafarers, or Explorers & Pirates, you get a different bord, with sea and islands and boats and pirates.
So it depends on what you are after really.

Not sure if everyone agrees with this, but I find that all the expansions adds playtime to the game, that might be both positive or negative, depending on who you ask.

I believe the most popular ones are Seafarers and Cities & Knights, I my self like Cities & Knights the most if I'm playing an expansion. So I would start with one of those personally if I were you. But you might find that after a while you want them all :)
